description: Invite people by email to open the app: one (`email`) or several at once (`emails`, up to 50). Each gets their own email with a link that works for 72 hours, and signs in with that address. Email only. The app must be claimed first (ACCOUNT_REQUIRED otherwise: tell the person to open their link and choose 'keep this app'). Without this tool, `npx uarpie share a@example.com b@example.com` does the same.

emails.description: Several people at once, up to 50.

project.description: Project id (prj_…) or the app's name (slug). Defaults to the project in deploy.json in the current directory.

name: share
title: Invite someone
